title: KALLAX shelving unit (5×5)
scope: Manual steps 1–29: assembling the frame, raising it and fixing it to the wall (two options). Excludes inserts.

overview.title: Check the parts
overview.hint: Check the panels and hardware against p5–p7. Only one set of the wall-attachment hardware is used, depending on the option chosen.

awayB.label: Upright, moved away from the wall

1.title: Top panel + left side panel
1.hint: Join the top panel and the left side panel at a right angle and drive in 2 long screws with the Z-shaped hex key.
1.motionNote: Motion source: the rotation arrow on wrench 100001 on p8 — the screw turns as it goes in, and the wrench turns with it.

2.title: Dowels for row 1 dividers
2.hint: For the 4 dividers of row 1, hammer 2 dowels into one edge of each.

3.title: Row 1 dividers
3.hint: Insert the 4 dividers into the top panel.

4.title: Dowels for the long shelves
4.hint: Hammer dowels into both ends of the 4 long shelves, 32 in total.

5.title: Long shelf 1
5.hint: Press the long shelf onto the dividers and into the left side panel.

6.title: Row 2 dowels
6.hint: On long shelf 1, hammer in 8 dowels for the next row of dividers.

8.title: Long shelf 2
8.hint: Press long shelf 2 onto the dividers and into the left side panel.

11.title: Long shelf 3
11.hint: Press long shelf 3 onto the dividers and into the left side panel.

14.title: Long shelf 4
14.hint: Press long shelf 4 onto the dividers and into the left side panel.

16.title: Row 5 dividers
16.hint: Fit the last row of 4 dividers.

17.title: Right side panel
17.hint: Turn the second side panel over and fit it onto the ends of all long shelves; mind the direction of the holes.

18.title: Top-right corner screws
18.hint: Drive 2 long screws into the corner between the right side panel and the top panel.
18.motionNote: Motion source: the rotation arrow on wrench 100001 on p21 — the screw turns as it goes in, and the wrench turns with it.

19.title: Last row of dowels
19.hint: Hammer 8 dowels into the exposed ends of the last row of dividers.

20.title: Bottom panel
20.hint: Turn the grey bottom panel over and fit it on.

21.title: Bottom panel screws
21.hint: Drive 2 long screws into each corner of the bottom panel, 4 in total.
21.motionNote: Motion source: the rotation arrow on wrench 100001 on p24 — the screw turns as it goes in, and the wrench turns with it.

22.title: Felt pads
22.hint: Stick 12 felt pads onto the grey face of the bottom panel.

23.title: Lift
23.hint: Two people lift the unit; mind where to hold it.

24.title: Raise
24.hint: Two people turn the unit upright. Next, choose the wall-attachment option that fits how the unit stands (p27).

a:25.title: Fit the wall fittings
a:25.hint: Use this option when the unit stands on the floor with its back against the wall. Fit one wall fitting under the top panel in the top-left and top-right compartments, 2 screws each.
a:25.motionNote: Motion source: the rotation arrow on the screwdriver on p27 — the screws turn as they go in.

a:26.title: Fix to the wall
a:26.hint: Check with a spirit level. Use round-head wall screws, driven through the keyhole plate and the large hole of the fitting into the wall. Wall screws and plugs are not included; buy them to suit your wall material.

a:27.title: Adjust and tighten
a:27.hint: The keyhole plate can be adjusted left-right and up-down; tighten once it is in place.
a:27.motionNote: Motion source: in the p29 detail circle, the left-right double arrow above the keyhole plate and the up-down double arrow beside it — first adjust left-right, then up-down; then tighten following the rotation arrow on the screwdriver.

a:28.motionNote: Motion source: the straight arrow beside the cover cap in the p30 detail circle — the cap is pushed onto the fitting.
a:28.title: Cover caps

b:25.title: Place brackets, mark
b:25.hint: Place the 2 brackets on the left end of the top panel with their holes over the screw holes in the top panel, and mark the bracket positions on the wall with a pencil.

b:26.title: Fix brackets to the wall
b:26.hint: Fix the brackets to the wall at the marks with round-head wall screws. Wall screws and plugs are not included; buy them to suit your wall material.
b:26.motionNote: Motion source: the rotation arrow on the screwdriver on p32 — the wall screws turn as they go in. In the p32 overall drawing the unit stands apart from the wall on the left.

b:27.title: Take out 2 long screws
b:27.hint: Use the Z-shaped hex key to take out the 2 long screws at the left end of the top panel (the two fitted in step 1).
b:27.motionNote: Motion source: the rotation arrow on the wrench on p33 (opposite to the screwing-in arrow on p35) and the two upward arrows — the screws turn as they come out.

b:28.title: Push under the brackets
b:28.hint: Push the unit towards the wall so that the brackets sit over the top panel.

b:29.title: Put the screws back
b:29.hint: Put the 2 long screws back through the brackets into the top panel.
b:29.motionNote: Motion source: the rotation arrow on wrench 100001 on p35 — the screw turns as it goes in, and the wrench turns with it.

a.label: Wall fitting
a.note: Option A: wall fitting 115753, unit standing on the floor with its back against the wall (p27–p30)

b.label: L-shaped bracket
b.note: Option B: L-shaped bracket 10091413, judged from the drawings to be the left side panel against the wall (p31–p35)

wall-screw.name: Wall screw (not included)
wall-screw.note: Not included; buy to suit your wall material (manual p2)
